hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo 'Open work (tools/board.py):' && uv run --quiet tools/board.py ls work && echo 'The open board, newest first:' && uv run --quiet tools/board.py ls idea skill knowledge result --new --n 100 && echo 'Team messages (tools/msg.py; times UTC):' && uv run --quiet tools/msg.py read && m=$(git log -1 --format=%cr -- meta/) && echo "Newest team-meta-review entry (meta/): ${m:-none}" && { [ -n "$EXA_API_KEY" ] || echo 'EXA_API_KEY is not set: the Exa MCP tools return 401 (README section 8).'; }
